title: Correlated Perfect Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2510.07906v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a refinement of correlated equilibrium based on common perturbations of the mediator's recommendation distribution, which we call correlated perfect equilibrium (CPE). In finite games, the set of CPEs is nonempty and forms a finite union of convex polyhedra. Like perfect equilibrium, a CPE never assigns positive probability to any weakly dominated strategy. We provide a dual representation of CPE, which yields an iterative procedure for identifying CPEs. These perturbations provide a common source of off-equilibrium beliefs, a feature that distinguishes CPE from two existing refinements of correlated equilibrium---acceptable correlated equilibrium (Myerson, 1986) and perfect direct correlated equilibrium (Dhillon and Mertens, 1996)---as we demonstrate through examples.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于调解人推荐分布的共同扰动对相关均衡进行精炼的概念，称之为相关完美均衡（CPE）。在有限博弈中，CPE的集合是非空的，并且构成凸多面体的有限并集。与完美均衡类似，CPE永远不会对任何弱被支配策略赋予正概率。我们给出了CPE的对偶表示，由此得到一个识别CPE的迭代程序。这些扰动为偏离均衡的信念提供了一个共同的来源，这一特征将CPE与两种现有的相关均衡精炼——可接受相关均衡（Myerson, 1986）和完美直接相关均衡（Dhillon and Mertens, 1996）——区分开来，我们通过具体例子展示了这一区别。
tldr: 本文提出相关完美均衡（CPE）这一相关均衡的新精炼，通过调解人推荐分布的共同扰动为偏离均衡信念提供共同来源，证明了其在有限博弈中非空且构成凸多面体的有限并集，并借助对偶表示给出了迭代识别CPE的方法。
